jobs.description:
Projektleiter:in Elektro Infrastrukturprojekte 80-100% - Zürich — AFRY, Zürich.

Stellenbeschreibung
			Werden Sie Teil unserer Abteilung Bahntechnik & Mobilität. Wir planen die Schweizer Infrastruktur für kommende Generationen. Unsere Kunden sind Schweizer Eisenbahnunternehmen, Flughäfen und Verkehrsbetriebe. Mit unseren Projekten schaffen wir die Grundlage für den zunehmenden Personen- und Güterverkehr bis 2050. Für unsere Kunden entwickeln wir die technische Lösung vom Vorprojekt bis zur Inbetriebnahme.

Übernehmen Sie bei uns Verantwortung als:
PROJEKTLEITER:IN ELEKTRO INFRASTRUKTURPROJEKTE 80-100% - ZÜRICH
IHRE AUFGABEN:

• Leitung von interdisziplinären Infrastrukturprojekten mit Schwerpunkt im Elektrobereich (Erweiterung Bahnhöfe, Ladeinfrastruktur, 5G für die Eisenbahn / FRMCS, Beleuchtungsanlagen)

• Koordination der involvierten Fachbereiche zusammen mit den Teilprojektleitern und Fachspezialisten

• Bearbeitung von Projekten gemäss SIA-Phasen vom Vorprojekt bis zur Inbetriebnahme (die Projektdauer kann bis zu 10 Jahre betragen)

• Verantwortung für Termine, Qualität und Kosten

• Kommunikation und Koordination mit Bauherren, Planungspartnern, Behörden, Auftragnehmern und beteiligten Unternehmen

• Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung von Offerten
IHRE CHANCEN:

• Spannende und vielseitige Projekte in interdisziplinären Teams – gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns die Infrastruktur der Zukunft

• Flexible Arbeitsweise mit moderner Infrastruktur und der Möglichkeit von Home Office

• Bringen Sie Ihr Engagement in einem fortschrittlichen und nachhaltigen Unternehmen mit internationalem Netzwerk ein
IHR PROFIL:

• Abschluss als Ingenieur:in ETH oder FH in Elektrotechnik oder vergleichbar

• Erfahrung als Projektleiter:in in Infrastrukturanlagen

• Erfahrung in der Projektabwicklung nach SIA-Phasen

• Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Projekten und Genehmigungsverfahren

• Freude an der Arbeit im Team

• Selbständige und effiziente Arbeitsweise

• Kommunikative und kundenorientierte Persönlichkeit

• Gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, weitere Landessprachen sind von Vorteil

Werden Sie Teil der AFRY-Erfolgsgeschichte! Wir bieten Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung, kollegiale und internationale Arbeitsatmosphäre, zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen, flexible Arbeitsmodelle, überdurchschnittliche Sozialleistungen, attraktive Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und grosszügige Beteiligung am ÖV Abo sowie ein Halbtax damit Sie unsere modernen Bürogebäude an zentraler Lage bestens erreichen.
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre online Bewerbung!

Unternehmensbeschreibung
			AFRY bietet Ingenieur-, Projektmanagement- und Beratungsdienstleistungen an, welche die Energiewende sowie die industrielle Transformation unterstützen und die gesellschaftliche Resilienz stärken. Mit weltweit 18.000 Expertinnen und Experten vereinen wir globale Reichweite mit lokalem Fachwissen und umfassender Branchenkenntnis, um die Zukunft kommender Generationen nachhaltig zu gestalten.
Making Future

Zusätzliche Informationen
			Bei AFRY sorgen wir bei allem, was wir tun, für Veränderungen. Denn Wandel entsteht nur, wenn mutige Ideen zusammenkommen. Wenn wir erfolgreich zusammenarbeiten, innovativ tätig sind und unterschiedliche Blickwinkel einnehmen. So gestalten wir die Zukunft. Wir sind aktiv auf der Suche nach qualifizierten Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern, die ein Teil unserer integrativen und vielfältigen Teams auf der ganzen Welt werden möchten. Responsabile del progetto: nei progetti di infrastruttura elettrica 80-100% - Zurigo — AFRY, Zurigo.

Descrizione del lavoro
Diventa parte del nostro dipartimento di tecnologia e mobilità ferroviaria. Progettiamo l'infrastruttura svizzera per le generazioni future. I nostri clienti sono aziende ferroviarie, aeroporti e compagnie di trasporto svizzere. Con i nostri progetti, stiamo gettando le basi per aumentare il trasporto passeggeri e merci entro il 2050. Per i nostri clienti, sviluppiamo la soluzione tecnica dal progetto preliminare alla messa in servizio.

Assumere la responsabilità con noi come:
PROGETTORE: IN ELEKTRO INFRASTRUCTURE PROGETTI 80-100% - AUGHTER
ITS:

• Gestione di progetti infrastrutturali interdisciplinari con particolare attenzione al settore elettrico (estensione stazioni, infrastrutture di ricarica, 5G per ferrovie / FRMCS, sistemi di illuminazione)

• Coordinamento dei dipartimenti coinvolti insieme ai project manager e agli specialisti

• Elaborazione di progetti secondo fasi SIA dal pre-progetto alla messa in servizio (la durata del progetto può essere fino a 10 anni)

• Responsabilità per scadenze, qualità e costi

• Comunicazione e coordinamento con costruttori, partner di pianificazione, autorità, appaltatori e società partecipanti

• Cooperazione nella preparazione delle offerte
Le tue opportunità:

• Progetti emozionanti e versatili in team interdisciplinari - modellano l'infrastruttura del futuro insieme a noi

• Metodo di lavoro flessibile con infrastrutture moderne e la possibilità di ufficio domestico

• Porta il tuo impegno a una società progressiva e sostenibile con una rete internazionale
Il tuo problema.

• Laurea come ingegnere: in ETH o FH in ingegneria elettrica o comparabile

• Esperienza come project manager: nelle infrastrutture

• Esperienza nell'implementazione del progetto secondo le fasi SIA

• Esperienza con progetti pubblici e procedure di approvazione

• Il piacere di lavorare in una squadra

• Pratiche di lavoro indipendenti ed efficienti

• Personalità comunicativa e orientata al cliente

• Buona conoscenza orale e scritta di tedesco e inglese, altre lingue nazionali sono un vantaggio

Diventa parte della storia di successo AFRY! Offriamo leeway creativo e responsabilità personale, un ambiente di lavoro collegiale e internazionale, condizioni di lavoro contemporaneo, modelli di lavoro flessibili, benefici sociali al di sopra della media, opportunità di sviluppo attraenti e la partecipazione generosa all'abbonamento ai trasporti pubblici e una semi-tassa in modo da poter raggiungere i nostri moderni edifici per uffici in una posizione centrale.
Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione online!

Descrizione aziendale
AFRY offre servizi di ingegneria, project management e consulenza che supportano la transizione energetica e la trasformazione industriale e rafforzano la resilienza sociale. Con 18.000 esperti in tutto il mondo, combiniamo la portata globale con competenze locali e una vasta conoscenza del settore per plasmare il futuro delle generazioni future in modo sostenibile.
Rendere il futuro

Ulteriori informazioni
A AFRY, facciamo cambiamenti in tutto quello che facciamo. Perché il cambiamento viene solo quando le idee audaci si uniscono. Quando lavoriamo insieme con successo, innovare e prendere prospettive diverse. E' cosi' che formiamo il futuro. Siamo attivamente alla ricerca di candidati qualificati che vogliono diventare parte dei nostri team inclusi e diversi in tutto il mondo. Unisciti a noi per accelerare la transizione verso un futuro più sostenibile.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Project manager:in Electrical Infrastructure Projects 80-100% - Zurich — AFRY, Zurich.

Job description
Become part of our Railway Technology & Mobility department. We plan the Swiss infrastructure for future generations. Our customers are Swiss railway companies, airports and transport companies. With our projects, we are laying the foundation for increasing passenger and freight transport by 2050. For our customers, we develop the technical solution from the preliminary project to commissioning.

Take responsibility with us as:
PROJECTOR: IN ELEKTRO INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS 80-100% - AUGHTER
ITS TASKS:

• Management of interdisciplinary infrastructure projects with a focus on the electrical sector (extension of stations, charging infrastructure, 5G for railways / FRMCS, lighting systems)

• Coordination of the departments involved together with the project managers and specialists

• Processing of projects according to SIA phases from pre-project to commissioning (the project duration can be up to 10 years)

• Responsibility for deadlines, quality and costs

• Communication and coordination with builders, planning partners, authorities, contractors and participating companies

• Cooperation in the preparation of offers
Your opportunities:

• Exciting and versatile projects in interdisciplinary teams – shape the infrastructure of the future together with us

• Flexible working method with modern infrastructure and the possibility of home office

• Bring your commitment to a progressive and sustainable company with an international network
YOUR PROFILE:

• Degree as an engineer: in ETH or FH in electrical engineering or comparable

• Experience as a project manager: in infrastructure facilities

• Experience in project implementation according to SIA phases

• Experience with public projects and approval procedures

• Enjoyment of working in a team

• Self-employed and efficient working practices

• Communicative and customer-oriented personality

• Good oral and written knowledge of German and English, other national languages are an advantage

Become part of the AFRY success story! We offer creative leeway and personal responsibility, a collegial and international working atmosphere, contemporary employment conditions, flexible working models, above-average social benefits, attractive development opportunities and generous participation in public transport subscription as well as a half-tax so that you can reach our modern office buildings in a central location.
We look forward to your online application!

Business description
AFRY offers engineering, project management and consulting services that support the energy transition and industrial transformation and strengthen social resilience. With 18,000 experts worldwide, we combine global reach with local expertise and extensive industry knowledge to shape the future of future generations in a sustainable way.
Making the future

Additional information
At AFRY, we make changes in everything we do. Because change only comes when bold ideas come together. When we work together successfully, innovate and take different perspectives. This is how we shape the future. We are actively looking for qualified applicants who want to become part of our inclusive and diverse teams around the world. Join us to accelerate the transition to a more sustainable future.

jobs.title: Project Engineer for Data Analytics and Simulation (f/m/d) 80-100% - Zurich
jobs.description:
Project Engineer for Data Analytics and Simulation (f/m/d) 80-100% - Zurich — AFRY, Zürich.

Job Description
			Join our Technics & Technology team in Zurich. The team has a unique competence in Engineering Simulation and Data Analytics. The team develops methods and tools for application to real engineering problems, covering a variety of sectors, ranging from energy and processes to water and infrastructures, though environment. This competence unit is seeking to hire a new person, with a dual profile: CFD and Data Analytics.

Join us and take charge as:
PROJECT ENGINEER FOR DATA ANALYTICS AND SIMULATION (F/M/D) 80-100% - ZURICH
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and execute simulation studies to assess the feasibility and performance of engineering systems and processes

• Analyze, process, and interpret data from sensors, monitoring systems, and industrial IoT platforms

• Apply machine learning algorithms to both real-world sensor data and synthetic simulation data

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to translate technical challenges into data-driven solutions

• Support the development of digital engineering, analytics, and simulation workflows
YOUR CHANCES:

• Shape the future with cutting-edge technology

• Challenge yourself with complex, real-life problems

• Flexible working models with the option to work from home, as well as modern office facilities in a central location

• Collaborate in diverse teams and work alongside competent, driven, and supportive colleagues

• Partner with leading clients and build a better future
YOUR PROFILE:

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering (preferably mechanical engineering) or applied mathematics

• Additional advanced training in data science

• Hands-on experience with industrial CFD software such as Star-CCM+, ANSYS Fluent, or OpenFOAM as well as with advanced data analytics platforms is a strong advantage

• Capability to code in Python and knowledge of Azure cloud systems or interest to develop

• Proficient in English with basic German language skills

Learn more about the Department:
 Engineering Simulation & Data Analytics - Kompetenz | AFRY

Become part of the AFRY success story! We offer creative freedom and personal responsibility, a supportive and international working environment, up-to-date employment terms, flexible working arrangements, above-average perks, attractive development opportunities and generous contributions towards your public transport passes as well as a Half-Fare card, so that you can easily reach our modern office buildings in central locations.
We look forward to receiving your online application!

Company Description
			AFRY provides engineering, project management, and advisory services that enable the energy and industrial transition and strengthen resilience in society. With 18,000 experts worldwide, we combine a global reach with local insights and deep sector knowledge to make a lasting impact for generations to come.
Making Future

Additional Information
			At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Project Engineer per l'analisi dei dati e la simulazione (m/f/d) 80-100% - Zurigo. AFRY, Zurigo.

Descrizione Unisciti al nostro team Technics & Technology di Zurigo. Il team ha una competenza unica in Ingegneria Simulazione e Analisi dei Dati. Il team sviluppa metodi e strumenti per l'applicazione a problemi di ingegneria reali, che coprono una varietà di settori, che vanno dall'energia e processi all'acqua e alle infrastrutture, anche se l'ambiente.

Unisciti a noi e prenditi la responsabilità come: ENGINEER DI PROGETTO PER L'ANALISI DEI DATI E LA SIMULAZIONE (M/F/D) 80-100% - ZURICH

Responsabilità - Sviluppare ed eseguire studi di simulazione per valutare la fattibilità e le prestazioni dei sistemi e dei processi ingegneristici - Analizzare, elaborare e interpretare i dati provenienti da sensori, sistemi di monitoraggio e piattaforme industriali IOT - Applicare algoritmi di apprendimento automatico ai dati dei sensori reali e ai dati di simulazione sintetica - Collaborare con team di ingegneria multidisciplinare per tradurre le sfide tecniche in soluzioni basate sui dati - Sostenere lo sviluppo di processi di ingegneria digitale, di analisi e simulazione

Requisiti - Laurea in ingegneria (preferibilmente meccanica) o matematica applicata - Formazione avanzata supplementare in scienze dei dati - Esperienza pratica con software CFD industriale come Star-CCM+, ANSYS Fluent, o OpenFOAM, nonché con piattaforme avanzate di analisi dei dati è un forte vantaggio - Capacità di codificare in Python e conoscenza dei sistemi cloud Azure o interesse a sviluppare - Competenza in inglese con competenze di base in lingua tedesca

Cosa offriamo - Formate il futuro con tecnologie all'avanguardia - Sfidatevi di problemi complessi e reali - Modelli di lavoro flessibili con la possibilità di lavorare da casa, così come moderne strutture per uffici in una posizione centrale - dialogate in team diversificati e lavorate insieme a colleghi competenti, guidati e solidali - Collaborate con clienti leader e costruite un futuro migliore - Libertà creativa e responsabilità personale - Un ambiente di lavoro solidale e internazionale - Condizioni di lavoro aggiornate - Accordi di lavoro flessibili - Percorsi di lavoro superiori alla media - Sviluppo attraente

opportunità - Generosi contributi ai vostri trasporti pubblici e una carta Mezza corsa, in modo da poter raggiungere facilmente i nostri moderni edifici per uffici in posizioni centrali.

Descrizione aziendale AFRY fornisce servizi di ingegneria, gestione dei progetti e consulenza che consentono la transizione energetica e industriale e rafforzano la resilienza nella società. Con 18.000 esperti in tutto il mondo, combiniamo una portata globale con approfondimenti locali e conoscenze di settore per avere un impatto duraturo per le generazioni future.

Ulteriori informazioni In AFRY, noi ingegnerizziamo cambiare in tutto ciò che facciamo. Il cambiamento avviene quando idee coraggiose si riuniscono. Quando collaboriamo, innoviamo la tecnologia e abbracciamo punti di vista impegnativi. Questo è il modo in cui stiamo facendo il futuro. Stiamo attivamente cercando candidati qualificati per unirsi ai nostri team inclusivi e diversi in tutto il mondo. Unisciti a noi per accelerare la transizione verso un futuro sostenibile.

jobs.description:
Junior Projektingenieur:in Leitungsbau 80-100% - Zürich — AFRY, Zürich.

Stellenbeschreibung
			Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams Transmission & Distribution. Wir sind seit Jahrzehnten auf dem Gebiet der Planung von Anlagen zur Übertragung und Verteilung von elektrischer Energie tätig. Die Behandlung der dazugehörigen umweltrelevanten Aspekte rundet unsere Dienstleistungen ab.
Übernehmen Sie bei uns Verantwortung als: JUNIOR PROJEKTINGENIEUR:IN LEITUNGSBAU 80-100% - ZÜRICH
IHRE AUFGABEN:

• Unterstützung bei der fachtechnischen Bearbeitung von Projekten, z. B. bei einfachen Berechnungen, technischen Spezifikationen, Dokumentationen und Berichten.

• Mitarbeit bei der Planung von Leitungsbauprojekten – von der ersten Trassenfindung über vorbereitende Projektierungsaufgaben bis hin zur Begleitung späterer Projektphasen.

• Teilnahme an Abstimmungen mit internen Stellen und Begleitung von Kund:innen‑ oder Behördenterminen

• Zuarbeit beim Erarbeiten von Entscheidungsgrundlagen, z. B. durch Recherchen, technische Vergleiche oder Aufbereitung von Unterlagen.

• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Termin‑ und Kostenübersichten sowie bei der Pflege projektbezogener Planungsunterlagen.
IHRE CHANCEN:

• Spannende und herausfordernde Projekte mit einem breiten und abwechslungsreichen Aufgabenfeld

• Sie arbeiten in einer wachsenden Organisation, für die Nachhaltigkeit und zukunftsorientierte Technologien wichtig sind

• Gezielte persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Maximal flexible Arbeitsweise mit der Möglichkeit des mobilen Arbeitens / Home-Office

• Moderne Büroräumlichkeiten mit neuester Infrastruktur an verkehrsgünstiger Lage beim Bahnhof Zürich-Altstetten

Qualifikationen
			IHR PROFIL:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium (FH/Uni) in Elektrotechnik, Bauingenieurwesen, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.

• Erste praktische Einblicke (z. B. durch Praktika, Werkstudierendentätigkeiten oder Projektarbeiten) im Bereich Leitungsbau oder Energietechnik

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, sowie Französisch- oder Italienischkenntnisse von Vorteil

• Grundverständnis der relevanten technischen Normen und gesetzlichen Grundlagen im Bereich Energie/Leitungsbau

• Erste Erfahrungen in der Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden oder Fachstellen sind hilfreich aber nicht zwingend erforderlich

• Sorgfältige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung Schritt für Schritt zu übernehmen.

• Teamorientierte, kommunikative Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team

Job description
Become part of our team Environment and Landscape. You can expect versatile and challenging new construction and repair projects in the areas of: road and rail infrastructure, water supply and sewage treatment, civil engineering, energy production and transmission as well as flood protection and water revitalization.

Take responsibility with us as:
PROJECTOR: IN THE ENVIRONMENT 60-100% - AUGHTER
ITS TASKS:

• Development of environmental planning, environmental impact assessments and environmental studies and expertise (e.g. noise protection, soil protection, contaminated sites, waste, accident, nature) in an interdisciplinary project team

• Processing of versatile and challenging projects of different sizes in environmental planning, environmental impact assessment and/or environmental construction monitoring

• For larger projects: guided by the technical and technical team of experts to provide high-quality environmental documentation on time

• Advising our customers across all project phases: from strategic planning to commissioning

• Active acquisition of new mandates, preparation of offers and assumption of financial and administrative project management

Your opportunities:

• Co-creating exciting, challenging and complex projects with a wide range of tasks

• Interdisciplinary cooperation within and outside the project teams with experienced project managers: experts from a wide range of disciplines

• Flexible working method with modern infrastructure and the possibility of home office

• Personal and professional further development through a broad range of further education

YOUR PROFILE:

• Environmental engineer:in, environmental scientist:in, geographer:in, earth scientist:in, biologist (or equivalent training)

• At least 5 years of professional experience as a project manager: in environmental planning or environmental construction support of infrastructure facilities in Switzerland, in the areas of road (ASTRA, TBA), rail (SBB, RhB, MGB, SOB) or energy

• Training/recognition as soil accompaniment: in is advantageous

• familiar with Swiss environmental legislation

• Good oral and written knowledge of German. Knowledge of French and/or Italian and/or English is an advantage

• Technical, organizational and communication skills in the team and in contact with customers, partners and authorities

Become part of the AFRY success story! We offer creative leeway and personal responsibility, a collegial and international working atmosphere, contemporary employment conditions, flexible working models, above-average social benefits, attractive development opportunities and generous participation in public transport subscription as well as a half-tax so that you can reach our modern office buildings in a central location.
We look forward to your online application!

We would like to fill this position without the support of external service providers.

Business description
AFRY offers engineering, project management and consulting services that support the energy transition and industrial transformation and strengthen social resilience. With 18,000 experts worldwide, we combine global reach with local expertise and extensive industry knowledge to shape the future of future generations in a sustainable way.
Making the future

Additional information
At AFRY, we make changes in everything we do. Because change only comes when bold ideas come together. When we work together successfully, innovate and take different perspectives. This is how we shape the future. We are actively looking for qualified applicants who want to become part of our inclusive and diverse teams around the world. Join us to accelerate the transition to a more sustainable future.

Project manager:in the field of water & wastewater 80–100% – Zurich — AFRY, Zurich.

Job description
Become part of our team WATER & ENVIRONMENT. We accompany infrastructure and energy projects with the aim of improving the efficiency of energy, water and material cycles. Support us in the project planning and implementation of municipal and industrial wastewater treatment plants and municipal drainage plants. We work on lighthouse projects at facilities such as the ara region bern ag, STEP Aire Genève, ARA Frauenfeld, REAL ARA Buholz and many more.
Plan with us the sustainable infrastructure facilities of tomorrow that contribute to the improvement of water quality in rivers and lakes and at the same time inspire our builders through innovative and customer-oriented solutions.

Take responsibility with us as:
PROJECTOR: IN THE FIELD OF WATER & WASTE 80-100% – AUSTRIA
ITS TASKS:

• Overall management of projects in the field of wastewater treatment or urban drainage

• Projecting and realization of process plants and structures in the industry standard

• Successful management of interdisciplinary project teams

• Advising and supporting existing and new customers over the entire project life cycle (strategic planning to commissioning and management)

• Applying, implementing and continuously optimising the BIM methodology
Your opportunities:

• Exciting lighthouse projects in the field of infrastructure, environmental and wastewater technology

• Collaboration with committed, motivated and interdisciplinary teams beyond Zurich

• Engagement in a progressive and sustainable company with an international network

• Development opportunities for the overall project manager of ambitious large-scale projects in sewage plant construction

• Development opportunities for taking on team management tasks
YOUR PROFILE:

• Successfully completed studies as an environmental, civil or cultural engineer: in (ETH/FH)

• 5 to 10 years of professional experience as project manager:in and project engineer:in, ideally in the areas of municipal and industrial wastewater technology incl. Experience in specialist management

• Experience in collaborative collaboration in BIM projects

• In-depth organizational and communicative skills, which are used both in the team and in contact with customers and partners

• Very good knowledge of German in words and writing, English and / or French skills are a plus

Become part of the AFRY success story! We offer creative leeway and personal responsibility, a collegial and international working atmosphere, contemporary employment conditions, flexible working models, above-average social benefits, attractive development opportunities and generous participation in public transport subscription as well as a half-tax so that you can reach our modern office buildings in a central location.
We look forward to your online application!

Business description
AFRY offers engineering, project management and consulting services that support the energy transition and industrial transformation and strengthen social resilience. With 18,000 experts worldwide, we combine global reach with local expertise and extensive industry knowledge to shape the future of future generations in a sustainable way.
Making the future

Additional information
At AFRY, we make changes in everything we do. Because change only comes when bold ideas come together. When we work together successfully, innovate and take different perspectives. This is how we shape the future. We are actively looking for qualified applicants who want to become part of our inclusive and diverse teams around the world. Join us to accelerate the transition to a more sustainable future.

BAULEITER:IN HOCHBAU / GESAMTPLANUNG 80–100% - ZÜRICH
Ihre Aufgaben

• Selbständige Bauleitung anspruchsvoller Infrastrukturprojekte für die Abteilungen Gesamtplanung und Tragwerkplanung

• Verantwortung für die Koordination und Überwachung der Bauausführung hinsichtlich Qualität, Kosten und Termine

• Führung und Abstimmung von Unternehmern, Fachplanern, Behörden und weiteren Projektbeteiligten

• Erstellung von Ausschreibungen, Devisierungen, Werkverträgen sowie Termin- und Bauprogrammen

• Leitung von Bausitzungen inklusive Protokollierung und Baustellenrapportierung

• Gute Kenntnisse der Schweizer Normen sowie des Bau- und Vertragswesens (SIA)

• Erfahrung in Ausschreibung und Devisierung mit NPK/CRB

• Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und digitalen Bauadministrationstools

• Strukturierte, selbständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Kommunikationsstarke, durchsetzungsfähige und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Descrizione del lavoro
			A partire da agosto 2026 offriamo una formazione supplementare nella nostra filiale a Bellinzona:
PIANIFICATORE ELETTRICISTA AFC (f/m/d) (secondo apprendistato) – BELLINZONA
Durante l'apprendistato imparerai, tra le altre cose, le seguenti attività:

• Elaborazione di progetti di impianti e di schemi elettrici con l'ausilio di un software CAD

• Sviluppo di soluzioni e l’allestimento dei relativi piani di dettaglio

• Dimensionamento di linee elettriche ed elettro sistemi complessi

• Coordinamento tecnico con i partecipanti al progetto, interni ed esterni all’azienda

• Conduzione dell'esecuzione in loco e coordinamento con le altre discipline

• Progettazione indipendente di installazioni
Per l'apprendistato, dovresti preferibilmente portare il seguente profilo:

• Completamento della scuola primaria

• Formazione terminata quale montatore elettricista AFC o elettricista di montaggio AFC

• Interessi / punti di forza in geometria, matematica e fisica

• Interesse per il disegno tecnico e capacità di lavorare in modo preciso

• Buona consapevolezza dello spazio e comprensione tecnica

• Interesse per i processi di costruzione di infrastrutture, gallerie, installazioni ferroviarie e stradali.

• Aperto a nuove idee, motivato e appassionato
Offriamo una formazione completa, variata e stimolante all’interno dell’affascinante mondo di uno studio di ingegneria internazionale.
Durante i due anni di formazione avrai la possibilità di cimentarti in tutti i campi dell’ingegneria civile e concluderai il tuo apprendistato con l’ottenimento dell’attestato federale di capacità AFC.
Entra a far parte della grande storia di AFRY! Ti offriamo un apprendistato entusiasmante e vario in un ambiente di lavoro collegiale e aperto con condizioni d’impiego all’avanguardia e infrastrutture moderne.

Description du poste
			Rejoignez notre équipe CVCS ! Nous concevons, développons, planifions et supervisons des projets dans le secteur de la construction/industriel de tous types, de la première idée à la mise en œuvre.

Venez rejoindre et renforcer notre équipe et assumez des responsabilités comme :
CHEF DE PROJET CVCS EXPERIMENTE (F/H/D) 80-100% – LAUSANNE / FRIBOURG
VOS TACHES

• Chef de projet pour des mandats de conception dans le secteur CVCS (bâtiment et industrie)

• Gestion de projets, en garantissant le respect de la qualité, des coûts et des délais

• Gestion de l'équipe de projet

• Consultation et accompagnement des clients dans toutes les phases du projet, de la planification stratégique à la mise en service et à l'optimisation finale

• Développement de projets conceptuels, faisabilité technique, implémentations de solutions innovantes, donner conseils aux clients sur l'efficacité économique au cours du cycle de vie d’un immeuble
VOTRE PROFIL

• Formation supérieure dans le domaine d’activité concerné ;

• Diplôme technique HS/HES dans le domaine CVCS constitue un avantage

• Plusieurs années d’expérience en tant que chef de projet dans la planification d'installations CVCS en Suisse

• Disponibilité à la collaboration interdisciplinaire avec les autres bureaux de Bellinzona et Zürich

• Bonnes connaissances des lois et règlementations suisses en matière d’ingénierie systèmes

• Bonnes capacités d'organisation et de communication au sein de l'équipe et avec les clients

• Autonomie, flexibilité, proactivité et esprit d'entreprise

• Exactitude et ponctualité dans l'exécution de vos tâches

• Langue maternelle française, des connaissances orales et écrites de l'anglais, de l'allemand ou de l'italien sont un avantage

• La connaissance des méthodologies de conception numérique (BIM) est un atout

Contribuez à l'histoire à succès d'AFRY ! Nous offrons une liberté créative et une responsabilité personnelle, une ambiance de travail collégiale et internationale, des conditions d'embauche contemporaines, une organisation du travail flexible, des prestations sociales au-dessus de la moyenne, des possibilités de développement attrayantes ainsi qu’une participation généreuse à l’abonnement des transports publics et un demi-tarif afin que vous puissiez rejoindre facilement nos bureaux modernes et facilement accessibles.
Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature en ligne !

Description de l'entreprise
			AFRY propose des services d’ingénierie, de gestion de projet et de conseil qui accompagnent la transition énergétique et industrielle, tout en contribuant à renforcer la résilience dans nos sociétés. Avec 18 000 experts à travers le monde, nous allions une portée internationale à une connaissance approfondie des divers contextes locaux et industriels, afin de générer un impact durable pour les générations futures.
Making Future

Informations supplémentaires
			Chez AFRY, nous sommes des ingénieurs du changement dans tout ce que nous faisons. Le changement se produit lorsque des idées courageuses se rencontrent. Lorsque nous collaborons, innovons en matière de technologie et adoptons des points de vue stimulants. C'est ainsi que nous construisons l'avenir. Nous recherchons activement des candidats qualifiés pour rejoindre nos équipes inclusives et diversifiées dans le monde entier. Rejoignez-nous pour accélérer la transition vers un avenir durable.

• Sie sind als Gesamtprojektleiter:in verantwortlich für die erfolgreiche Abwicklung anspruchsvoller Verkehrs-Infrastrukturprojekte

• Sie führen interdisziplinäre Projektteams und Ingenieurgemeinschaften

• Spannende Projekte im Verkehrs-Infrastrukturbereich
